adjudication.rationale: Diff shows `TopicEmbed.import` now sets `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If no matching `EmbeddableHost` record exists, `eh` is nil and the category argument becomes nil. The old global fallback `SiteSetting.embed_category` was removed from settings/locales and deleted in the migration, so there is no longer an explicit default category for the no-match path. While other code paths (e.g., TopicRetriever / EmbedController) now gate on `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`, `TopicEmbed.import` itself can be called independently and there is no test covering the no-host-record case, so the review concern about an unpinned behavioral edge case is grounded.
